name: Newton County, GA
findings: Newton County has 300 nonprofit organizations. 91 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 64 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Newton County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Newton County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 110 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 7 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 20 would.

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?
